user.title: West Dunbartonshire School Meals
user.description: Unofficial, and not affiliated with West Dunbartonshire Council. It shows the school meal menus the council publishes on its website, which can change at short notice and may not match what a child is served. Always check menus and allergens with the school yourself; do not rely on this integration, especially for allergies or medical diets. After setup, add each child and their school from the integration page.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already set up. Add another child from the integration page instead.

data_description.weeks_ahead: How many weeks after this one the lunch calendars show.
data_description.allergens: Also read each dish's page for its allergens (for example "Gluten, Wheat, Milk"). About 20 extra requests the first day, then a few a week.

data_description.school: Council schools and nurseries. Private nurseries do their own food and are not listed.
data_description.name: Optional. With a name the device is called, for example, "Alex's School Meals".

stage.title: Which menu?
stage.description: {school} has more than one menu. Pick the one your child eats.

data_description.name: Optional. With a name the device is called, for example, "Alex's School Meals".

allergies.title: Allergies
allergies.description: Optional. Pick any allergens this child must avoid. Their device then gets two sensors that turn on when a dish that day lists one, using the council's published allergen information. That information has "may contain" warnings on some dishes only and may not match an adapted menu agreed with the school, so always check with the school.

data_description.watch_allergens: Leave empty to skip. Watching any allergen also reads each dish's page for its allergens.

abort.already_configured: This child is already set up for that school or menu.

options.gluten: Cereals containing gluten (wheat, rye, barley, oats)

next_school_day_grab_and_go.name: Next school day grab and go

menu_layout_changed.title: The {menu} menu page has changed
menu_layout_changed.description: The council's {menu} menu page ({url}) no longer looks the way this integration expects, so lunches cannot be read. Check for an update to West Dunbartonshire School Meals, or report it on the project's issue tracker.

term_dates_unreadable.title: School term dates cannot be read
term_dates_unreadable.description: The council's term dates pages ({url}) could not be read, so holidays and in-service days are not known. Every weekday shows a lunch until this is fixed. Check for an update to West Dunbartonshire School Meals.

get_menu.name: Get menu
get_menu.description: Gets a child's school lunch for a date, as response data: the choices, every course, vegetarian and allergen flags, and why there is no lunch on a closed day.

entity_id.name: Child
entity_id.description: Any entity of the child's device, for example their Today sensor.

date.name: Date
date.description: The day to look up. Leave empty for today.

not_a_child_entity.message: {entity_id} is not an entity of a West Dunbartonshire School Meals child.

not_loaded.message: West Dunbartonshire School Meals is not loaded.

menu_unavailable.message: The {menu} menu could not be fetched from the council site.
